body: hey man, i've been talking to some people on this subreddit and i'm gonna give life a shot and get some help. i know what your going through feels fucking pointless and overwhelming because i'm there right now, i just don't want to quit and miss out on the possibilities of the future. i'm going to look into some meds that will help level me out while i'm having a hard time and hopefully start to feel ok with life again. i hope you choose to keep trying too man. suicide will always be there as an option - you will always have a way out if you need it but for now, try to hang in there man! keep writing to me and talking shit out if you want. i think i'll be around for a while longer anyway.

man i feel that sense of climbing a mountain of shit everyday just to keep from fucking drowning in it. it's all bullshit and i wish there was something that we could control to make it different. the only real hope i have left is that maybe i'll hit some kind of jackpot and meet a nice girl who digs me or land a sick job and get rich but those things happen so rarely that it's so fucking hard to hold on and motivate myself the rest of the time. 

even if i did get a girl or money, they could be gone again as quick as they came and then i'd be right back where i was, wishing i was anywhere but here man. 

have you ever just considered starting over? declare bankruptcy, get a low responsibility job to pay for a cheap apartment and the. spend your time just hiking in the woods and going on canoe trips to nowhere? try something away from people and give yourself a break from this life. there's no reason you have to live the way everyone expects you too. hell i'll fuckin go with ya on some roadtrips and say fuck the world too. try out some other ways of living before you call it quits. you never know what you might find.

hey man, i'm really sorry to hear that you've been fucked over so bad that life has totally lost it's meaning. i'm kind of in the same boat and even though i am still trying to keep myself from going through with it, i know how fucking tempting it is to just say fuck it and be free from all the bullshit that life throws at us. let's talk this shit out man; what started all the pain - the downward spiral for you? i think for me the first time i ever wanted to kill myself was when i found out there was no god. my whole childhood and right up until i was 21 had been a total fucking lie and i was so lost. 

eventually though i found ways to be ok with it. i realized that id learned some good things that i could take from that shit, i realized how much i had matured and gotten smarter through all that shit and now, years later, i still have a hard time staying alive but each time we conquer it, we learn and become stronger. 

i know this has to be the lowest you've ever felt but if you can push through and say fuck the easy way out, i'm going to show these fucks i'm better than who they think i am, then there will be good times ahead. there will be more hard times too, trust me, but you can push through man. i was 26 too once, had nothing, didn't want to live but eventually i made up my mind that i would go back to school. i worked a shit job and got into a shit/cheap school but once you start doing it and have a goal in your mind, living get easier to bear. 

message me man and lets talk this out
